Scope: Bounded internal-link, category-directive, file-reference, fragment, and heading-anchor compatibility; no full MediaWiki navigation or thumbnail parity claim.

Architecture.ExpansionOrdering: Revision-aware MediaWikiTemplateExpander runs before the existing typed renderer.
Architecture.MediaResolution: ITwMediaWikiImportRepository.ResolveMediaAsync supplies imported attachment metadata for the existing permission-checked Binary route.
Architecture.UrlConstruction: Existing renderer base-path and escaped-navigation helpers are reused; no parallel router was introduced.

AuditFindings.Evidence: Basic, piped, namespace-qualified, Unicode, underscore/space-normalized, and template-expanded page links resolve through the imported page contract.
Local and page-qualified fragments are preserved in escaped URLs without claiming destination existence when heading metadata is unavailable.
Headings now receive bounded semantic-text IDs and duplicate base anchors receive deterministic numeric suffixes.
Category membership directives are typed per render, preserve sort-key metadata, and deduplicate exact repeats without database writes.
Leading-colon category links resolve the explicit Category: page and do not enter the directive collection.
Embedded File/Image references use the imported-media resolver while leading-colon File links use page resolution.
Existing HTTP/HTTPS allow-list, HTML encoding, rel policy, unsafe-scheme rejection, and control-character checks remain active.
Renderer-level filename validation rejects absolute, traversal, backslash, and NUL-containing references before resolver access.
Category persistence/index pages, generated thumbnails, remote media, complete namespace alias parity, and restricted metadata behavior remain outside the subset.

ConfirmedDefects.Issue: Internal-link fragments were discarded and headings had no imported anchor IDs.
ConfirmedDefects.Correction: Added bounded fragment-aware page/local URLs and deterministic heading IDs with duplicate suffixes.

ConfirmedDefects.Issue: Category directives projected the bare category title and leading-colon namespace links were not distinguished.
ConfirmedDefects.Correction: Added typed sort-key directives, explicit category/file link handling, and Category: page projection.

ConfirmedDefects.Issue: Media filename traversal safety depended on repository implementation.
ConfirmedDefects.Correction: Added renderer-boundary path validation before media resolution.

KnownLimitations: No complete MediaWiki heading-anchor historical algorithm claim.
Category membership is per-render metadata; no new persistence schema or write path was introduced.
Generated thumbnail parity and full media authorization/index semantics remain unavailable.
Historical parity, Cargo/Lua parity, host certification, and migration readiness remain independent gates.
RecommendedNextMilestone: Compare the bounded navigation/media subset against independently captured reference HTML while preserving application route and authorization boundaries.
